exposure: death of the fetus more proximal to the cervix (presenting twin)
cohort: The study included 46 multiple pregnancies with two viable fetuses confirmed prior to 20 weeks' gestation with the subsequent death of at least one twin, managed at The Royal Women's Hospital, Melbourne between 2006 and 2014.
finding: If the dead twin is presenting, delivery is likely to occur earlier with associated morbidity for the survivors, a finding more common in dichorionic twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean rates were significantly higher (67% versus 32%) when the dead twin was presenting.
